title: Mailbox
subtitle: This instance's own mailboxes, the platform mailboxes shared with it for sending, received mail, the send log and festival mail
scopeBanner: Only this instance's mailboxes are here: its chats can read mail only from its own mailboxes, and can also send through mailboxes the platform shares with it
selectInstance: Mailboxes belong to instances: pick an instance in the top bar first

accounts.platformHint: Mailboxes the platform shares with this instance. They can only send; their inbox is not visible. When this instance has its own default sender, that one is used first
accounts.platformEmpty: The platform shares no sending mailbox with this instance
accounts.platformEmptyPlatform: No platform sending mailbox yet. Add one and share it with instances; each instance's Agent can then send through it (its inbox stays unreadable).
accounts.ownHint: Mailboxes this instance added itself: mail they receive is readable only by this instance's chats; the authorization code can be written but not read back
accounts.emptyHint: Once a mailbox is added, this instance's chats can receive and send mail with it
accounts.transferDescription: Move {{address}} back to the platform: it becomes a platform mailbox, mail it receives is visible to the platform only, and its sharing is set to "not shared" for the platform to decide again.
accounts.deleteDescription: Delete {{address}}: the mail it received for this instance (cached copies) and the attachments are deleted with it and cannot be restored. The mailbox itself is not touched.

dialog.addressLocked: The address cannot be changed; delete this mailbox and add it again to use another address
dialog.displayNameHint: The address is shown when this is empty
dialog.passwordKeep: Already set; leave empty to keep it
dialog.passwordHint: Most providers want an app authorization code rather than the login password; it can be written but not read back
dialog.passwordRequiredAfterChange: The provider or a server changed: enter the authorization code again
dialog.customServersHint: The servers must be reachable from the internet: internal, loopback and transparent-proxy Fake-IP addresses are refused; ports can only be 993 / 143 (IMAP) and 465 / 587 / 25 (SMTP). Enter international domain names in their xn-- form.
dialog.notifyHint: Post a short note in this chat when new mail arrives (only this instance's chats)

sendLogs.emptyHint: Every mail this instance's chats send (successful or not) leaves a row here

userPrefs.hint: Addresses users asked the bot to remember in chat, and their festival mail subscriptions. Deleting clears only the address and the subscription; people who unsubscribed still get no festival mail.
userPrefs.emptyTitle: No user has saved an address yet
userPrefs.emptyHint: Saved when a user says "send mail to …" or subscribes to / unsubscribes from festival mail in chat
userPrefs.deleteDescription: Clear the saved address and subscription. If this person unsubscribed, that mark stays and festival mail is still not sent to them.

festival.hintTenant: Festival mail is sent by a queue at a steady pace per sending mailbox, and each mail is checked again right before it is sent (unsubscribed, sharing cancelled, plugin off, already sent today are skipped). Only the platform can pause or void a batch.
festival.hintPlatform: Festival mail is sent by a queue at a steady pace per sending mailbox, and each mail is checked again right before it is sent. Pausing stops only what has not been sent; voiding skips everything not yet sent and clears its body.
festival.emptyHint: Batches show up here once the festival greeting plugin queues mail for this instance's recipients on a festival

confirm.pauseDescription: Pause the mail of "{{festival}}" that has not been sent. Mail already sent is not affected; you can resume later.
confirm.resumeDescription: Resume the paused mail of "{{festival}}"; the queue continues sending at its steady pace.
confirm.voidDescription: Void all mail of "{{festival}}" that has not been sent: it is skipped and its body cleared. This cannot be undone.
